scientific_question: On the already consumed p=33kw_size=03 public development trajectory, can replacing the four-worker plus per-chunk coordinator runtime with exactly one persistent proposal worker preserve the frozen Dual-K1 numerical result and 2A+2A^T ledger while repairing the v16.1 fresh-process wall, CPU-time, and peak-RSS failures against Zero-CGLS K4?

frozen_mechanism.network_sample_arithmetic: unchanged float32 sample kernel and odd-pair unpacking from v13
frozen_mechanism.proposal_runtime: one persistent native proposal worker; no internal network worker pool; no per-chunk pthread_create or pthread_join
frozen_mechanism.candidate_solver: exact A^T lift -> observable alpha in [0,2] -> unchanged strict CGLS K1
frozen_mechanism.reference_solver: zero initialization -> unchanged strict CGLS K4

execution.arm_order: alternate the leading arm by repetition index so each arm leads exactly nine repetitions
execution.external_wall_scope: parent timer immediately before subprocess execve through child exit; includes Python startup, imports, observation load, geometry construction, checkpoint and native-context load for the candidate, solver execution, fsync field output, report serialization, and process teardown
execution.external_wall_excludes: one-time native library compilation performed before all worker repetitions
execution.peak_RSS_scope: whole worker process from parent os.wait4 child rusage after process exit
execution.CPU_time_scope: child user plus system CPU seconds from the same parent os.wait4 record

decision_rule: Numerical equivalence, deterministic repeats, exact operator ledgers, paired wall median reduction, paired faster fraction, paired wall no-harm, peak-RSS ratio, and child total-CPU-time ratio must all pass. No average-gain override, first-run deletion, threshold change, alternate thread count, or alternate batch size is allowed after execution.

failure_actions.numerical_or_ledger_failure: invalidate v17 and retain v16/v16.1 unchanged
failure_actions.wall_cpu_or_rss_failure: freeze the negative runtime result and stop tuning this runtime on p=33kw_size=03
failure_actions.all_gates_pass: record a post-open implementation repair only; do not claim independent generalization, real BOST, or paper success
